activity_summary: The cut knot lay on the board beside the hose, with Kemp's fork still in it. No face was in the picture.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Looked, and did not pick the fork out.

entities.name: Will Kemp
entities.context: His fork still in the knot. He is not in the picture.

facets.activity: Left Kemp's fork in the cut knot
